simple.meaning: הֵא (hêʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “lo!.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: הֵא (H1887) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 47:23, with occurrences in Genesis, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֵא (H1887) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in הֵא (H1887) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: הֵא (hêʼ) / H1887 is traced through Genesis 47:23, Ezekiel 16:43 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
